card.name: Commas in old-style lists and prose
card.fires_on: Mostly commas, and sometimes small words like "and", "it" or "a", inside old-fashioned, formal English text. It often falls in the middle of a list of items or properties, in 19th-century science or cookery writing.

modes.label: Comma in a list
modes.description: A comma or "and" between items in a series, such as properties or ingredients.

modes.label: Odd spots in old texts
modes.description: Single marks or letters in the middle of Greek, numbered tables or citations in old scholarly text.
